title: IBM SkillsBuild: Free AI and Tech Learning
description: IBM SkillsBuild provides free online learning in AI, cybersecurity, data and other technology topics, with digital credentials available for selected learning.
requirements: Create a free SkillsBuild account
Choose a learning pathway or course
Complete the requirements shown on the selected activity
qualifications: No formal qualification required for the general catalogue
steps: Open the official IBM SkillsBuild catalogue
Review the course or pathway requirements
Sign up or log in
Complete the selected learning activity
organisationDetails: IBM SkillsBuild is IBM's free learning platform for AI and technology skills.

title: Microsoft Learn Training and Career Paths
description: Microsoft Learn offers self-directed modules and learning paths for Microsoft technologies, plus career paths and student resources.
requirements: Select a learning path or module
Work through the content at your own pace
Use a Microsoft account when registration is required
qualifications: No formal qualification required for self-directed learning
steps: Browse the official training catalogue
Choose a module, learning path or career path
Sign in if prompted
Track progress and complete the learning activities
organisationDetails: Microsoft Learn is Microsoft's official training and documentation platform.

title: Grow with Google Career Learning
description: Grow with Google provides career learning and digital skills resources, including AI training and links to Google Career Certificates and other career tools.
requirements: Review the programme or course eligibility
Use the official provider page for enrolment details
Meet any partner or platform requirements
qualifications: Requirements vary by course or certificate
documents: Registration details requested by the selected provider
steps: Open the official Grow with Google career page
Choose a relevant course or certificate
Read the current terms and eligibility
Continue through the linked official provider
organisationDetails: Grow with Google is Google's official collection of career, digital skills and business learning resources.

title: AWS re/Start Cloud Skills Programme
description: AWS re/Start is a free, cohort-based programme that prepares unemployed or underemployed learners for entry-level cloud careers through technical training and professional skills development.
requirements: Check the eligibility criteria for the local cohort
Be available for the cohort schedule
Apply through an AWS re/Start training partner when a cohort is open
qualifications: Requirements vary by training partner and cohort
documents: Documents requested by the local training partner
steps: Read the official AWS re/Start information
Find an available training partner or cohort
Confirm eligibility and schedule
Apply through the partner's official process
organisationDetails: AWS re/Start is an Amazon Web Services workforce development programme delivered with training partners.

title: Find Opportunities on SAYouth.mobi
description: SAYouth is a South African public service platform where young people can create a profile and search for opportunities published on the network.
requirements: Be within the age range for the opportunity you choose
Create or use an SAYouth profile
Meet the requirements of each individual opportunity
documents: Documents requested by the selected opportunity
steps: Open the official SAYouth portal
Register or sign in
Search the opportunity listings
Apply only through the instructions for the selected listing
organisationDetails: SAYouth is an official South African youth opportunity platform; individual listings have their own closing dates and eligibility rules.

title: Information Technology Jobs in South Africa
description: CareerJunction publishes searchable South African vacancies, including information technology, software, support and related roles. Each vacancy has its own employer, requirements and expiry date.
requirements: Create or update a job-seeker profile where required
Review the employer's requirements for each vacancy
Apply before the individual vacancy expires
documents: Documents requested in the individual vacancy
steps: Open the official CareerJunction IT jobs search
Filter by role and location
Read the full vacancy details
Apply through the listing's stated process
organisationDetails: CareerJunction is a South African job-search platform. Opportunity details and deadlines belong to the individual employers.

title: Search Jobs and Internships on LinkedIn
description: LinkedIn's official jobs service lets candidates search for jobs and internships by role, location and industry, then review the employer's application instructions.
requirements: Create or use a LinkedIn account
Search by role and location
Meet the requirements for each individual posting
steps: Open the official LinkedIn jobs page
Search for a role or internship
Check the employer and closing information
Apply using the posting's stated route
organisationDetails: LinkedIn is a professional networking and jobs platform; each posting is controlled by its listed employer.

title: NSFAS Bursary Scheme Information
description: NSFAS provides financial aid information for eligible South African students at approved public universities and TVET colleges. Application windows and eligibility rules are published by NSFAS.
requirements: Be a South African citizen or meet the current NSFAS eligibility rules
Plan to study or be registered at an approved public institution
Meet the household-income and academic requirements for the relevant funding rules
qualifications: Requirements vary by funding category and institution
documents: Institution or academic information requested by NSFAS
steps: Open the official NSFAS website
Read the current bursary rules and application dates
Create or use the official account when applications are open
Submit only through the official NSFAS process
organisationDetails: NSFAS is South Africa's public student financial aid scheme. Application dates and requirements can change each cycle.
